ruling: Follow-up to PR #2485 (2026-09-28, data-quality finding). 952-vs-2,022: PR #2485 sampled the largest 10 of the 153 List-2-refused (run 36369192965) fromIds and reported 952 as an illustrative count, not a full census; this list is the full census, re-derived live on 2026-09-28. Two additional entries (Allan Castro cardsight::7f92af3bddc61b38fc6ab6df, Arjun Nimmala cardsight::6d03ef2658a5ab8828ad59d4) sit at bowman toId partitions (cpa-aca:refractor:auto:num-499, cpa-an:refractor:auto:num-499) that List 2 itself never refused (zero or unrefused sales at census time there) but that this task named directly -- included explicitly, plus every other stale sale this census independently found at those same two partitions (1 and 38 respectively), since the same defect shape applies to every sale in a partition once one is confirmed. Scope is deliberately NOT widened past the 153 List-2 fromId partitions + these 2 named ones -- a wider scan of the whole bowman cpa- checklist universe (3,765 catalog rows) was tried and rejected as an undocumented scope expansion beyond what this task named.
